subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept MXC 0.7.0 exposing the full sandbox command, environment, and policy envelope through `wxc-exec` process arguments for this early-preview plugin?
rationale: This is a confidentiality tradeoff against same-host process observers and requires explicit product and security authority even after the mechanical CI defect is fixed.

options.title: Accept as early preview
options.body: Approve the exact-head dependency graph, clearly document the argv visibility constraint, and track safer transport upstream.

options.title: Wait for safer transport
options.body: Pause the PR until microsoft/mxc#626 provides a file, stdin, pipe, or equivalent non-argv SDK transport.

recommendation.title: Accept as early preview
recommendation.body: Approve the exact-head dependency graph, clearly document the argv visibility constraint, and track safer transport upstream.
